deferredItems.reason: Dynamic slug returns 404 when fix data is unseeded. Route template is functionally intact; requires database content seed for fix entries rather than code mutation.

remediations.defect: Lacked explicit links to verified governance & methodology pages.
remediations.rootCauseAnalysis: Page omitted direct editorial governance section in initial layout.
remediations.resolution: Added Governance & Transparency section with verified links to /editorial-constitution, /methodology, /trust.

remediations.defect: Hardcoded grid-cols-2 squeezed metric text on narrow mobile screens (320px/375px).
remediations.rootCauseAnalysis: Fixed grid-cols-2 without small screen breakpoint forced 2-column layout on 320px viewports.
remediations.resolution: Converted grid layouts to grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4.

remediations.defect: Subscribe & Profile buttons hidden at tablet widths (768px-1023px).
remediations.rootCauseAnalysis: Header action container used hidden lg:flex while hamburger used md:hidden, creating a visibility gap between 768px and 1023px.
remediations.resolution: Changed button container class from hidden lg:flex to hidden md:flex.

remediations.defect: Drawer inner padding (p-6) caused tight text wrapping on 320px screens.
remediations.rootCauseAnalysis: Fixed 24px inner padding on 320px drawer width left only 272px for content.
remediations.resolution: Updated padding to p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-6 sm:space-y-8.

remediations.defect: D3 SVG chart width calculation pushed page container on initial render at 320px.
remediations.rootCauseAnalysis: Intrinsic D3 SVG width calculations during initial DOM mounting require controlled horizontal overflow on narrow screens (<375px). A responsive overflow container (w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl) was applied as the minimal solution after evaluating flex/grid sizing.
remediations.resolution: Wrapped chart panel in w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl.

lessonsLearned: Most responsive issues originated from fixed-width or fixed grid-column assumptions (grid-cols-2) on mobile viewports.
Navigation header layouts require explicit breakpoint tuning for intermediate tablet widths (768px–1023px).
Core accessibility infrastructure was structurally solid; minor remediations focused on element padding and dynamic label state toggles.
Existing design system tokens provided full styling coverage without requiring redesign or framework additions.
